context:
Goal: sessions and builders that work in a worktree can run ordinary single commands.
Problem (cannot undo): Claude Code's own worktree check, not one of ours, refuses plain commands; only Anthropic can fix it, and a public issue cannot be taken back.
Based on (measured): five sightings of four kinds since Nov 8; the latest made the guard test suite run unsharded, 1390 s.
Based on (read): none of our guards holds this refusal text; a grep of main finds nothing.
Departs from: main — adds a public issue on anthropics/claude-code.
Meanwhile: lanes run these commands from the main checkout, and step guard-shard-value-no-slash adds a shard form with no slash as a bandaid.

Draft issue text:

Title: Worktree isolation refuses simple single commands as "too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree"

In a session or subagent isolated in a git worktree, Claude Code refuses plain Bash commands with: "too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree". The commands are single commands run from the worktree root, with nothing chained, and each one stays inside the worktree. The same commands run in the main checkout.

Seen four ways:
1. A branch name that contains the word git is read as a second git call: `git push origin HEAD:git-dash-c-other-checkout` is refused.
2. A Python tool that runs git internally, in a session isolated with EnterWorktree: `python3 merge/merge.py --lane-lint 2314` is refused. It is refused again after a `cd` into the worktree.
3. The same command behind a wrapper script: `~/.claude/bin/verdict ~/.claude/bin/merge --lane-lint 2314` is refused. So is `~/.claude/bin/merge --lane-lint 2436` in a second subagent worktree.
4. An environment variable whose value holds a slash, in a subagent's worktree: `GUARD_SHARD=1/3 python3 bin/verdict python3 hooks/test_guard.py` is refused. The slash in the value seems to be read as a path.

Cost: in case 4 the test suite could not be split into shards, so it ran in one piece and took 1390 s. In cases 2 and 3 the check had to be moved to a different session.

Expected: a single command that names no path outside the worktree is allowed. A branch name or an environment variable value is not read as a command or a path.
